newsitem.title: GERMANY: Analyst comment on ProSieben price range.
newsitem.headline: Analyst comment on ProSieben price range.

text.p: Following are analysts' comments after German television group ProSieben Media AG said the 17.5 million preference shares in its bourse listing would be offered to investors in a range of 66-72 marks per share.
Pierre Drach, head of Frankfurt-based equity analysis Independent Research:

"I'm surprised at how cheap it is, we had expected 68 to 78. I now expect we will get a bookbuilding price of 72 marks which I would be very pleased with and we recommend subscribing to the shares. But I wouldn't necessarily recommend buying them at 100 marks (the grey market bid price at which ProSieben shares were indicated shortly after the price range was announced), it could be that we would issue a sell recommendation if the shares hit that level."
ProSieben shares were initally bid at 100 marks and offered at 110 marks, according to broker Schnigge+Partner GmbH of Duesseldorf on Reuters page RPDH.
The shares were later trading at 95.00/105.00 marks.
